facts.fact: Morocco's CESE avis, adopted 27 June 2024, says obstacles remain including the absence of a specific regulatory framework for AI.

MAR.note: Recommendations only; no government AI use stated.
Recommends priority sectors for AI; no sectoral AI tool stated.
CESE calls for a national AI strategy; does not state that none exists or is being written.
Names an AI centre and a call for projects with no model, dataset or computing stated; darija model only recommended.
Only a general mention of consumer protection laws, nothing on digital financial services.
Recommends revising Law 09-08 for AI; states no standing, authority, regulations or application.
Mentions UNESCO recommendations only; no standards body or IT standard.
Recommends a public-private AI fund and notes startup financing difficulty; no amount stated.
